about: The 1897 village's hooks from Magic's docs/magic/pass2-hooks-hogsmeade.md (req 2576): the High Street, the shops and inns by shop not by front, the village edge, the station and road. No spell is answered until Story rules (held in every row); the keepers are name to come. Place ids are provisional until Hogsmeade's pages name them. Built by tools/make-hogsmeade-1897-chain.py.
